marketing_description: The Lithonia Lighting Semi‑Regressed Wafer™ Downlight delivers 9 W of LED illumination at 120 V, 60 Hz, available in 2700 K to 5000 K color temperatures with a CRI of 90+ and dimmable operation. Its canless wafer design with a regressed lens reduces glare, while the air‑tight, IC‑rated housing and included remote driver simplify recessed installation in a 4‑in. trim, finished in matte white.
